question: Vitamin B12 is generally **NOT **present in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**plant foods**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin B12 is generally NOT present in plant foods**__. 

 __
 
• Plant-based foods are generally classified into fruits, vegetables, legumes, grains, nuts, and seeds and their derived processed counterparts.
 
• **Vitamin B12 is an essential vitamin found in foods such as meat, fish, and dairy.**
 
 
• It is required for the function and development of many parts of the body, including the brain, nerves, and blood cells.
